The '''Refugee Relief Movement (RRM)''' was a nonprofit organization originally formed to aid the billions of lower-class inhabitants of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It later grew to a disaster aid, relief fund, and resettlement agency operating on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Immediately prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]] served as the President of the Refugee Relief Movement. His wife [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal]] also worked at the RRM's [[Galactic City/Legends|galactic capital]] headquarters, which consisted of stark offices tucked under a recessed upper level of the [[Tannik Spaceport]]—itself a semicircular docking pad located at the edge of the [[Manarai Heights/Legends|Manarai district]] and surrounded by towering [[Monad/Legends|monads]]. The spaceport was a haven for crew members that had been drugged or abducted, itinerant workers, and the undocumented migrants of many species looking for steerage passage to distant worlds.<ref name="SWDP" />

===Palpatine's proposal for an RRM volunteer===
When she was a girl, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the Naberries' daughter, wished to work for the RRM and became one of its young volunteers, helping to evacuate [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]] before its destruction by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>

Indeed, it was in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]<ref name="Palpatine visit date">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} establishes that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was born in [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]]. According to [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] (25: The Discreet Charm of the Meritocracy), Padmé Amidala "has only just turned thirteen", which would place Palpatine's visit in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] visited the RRM headquarters to speak with the Naberries about their daughter Padmé, who had accompanied her parents from Naboo on their visit to Coruscant. As the adults conversed, the attractive, dark-haired young volunteer, along with her 'lovesick' friend [[Ian Lago]] (son of [[Kun Lago]], King [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna's]] [[Prime Councilor]]),<ref name="Summer's Dream">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref> directed the loading of [[Antigrav/Legends|antigrav]]-palleted foodstuffs into the bay of a waiting [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. Palpatine, who arrived at the port in a sky-cab that he'd hailed from the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]], had just come from his wedge-shaped offices behind the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Rotunda]], where he'd met that afternoon with the revered [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku]] who had privately announced to him his intentions to leave the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] (Dooku, brooding in the aftermath of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] debacle that was the [[Battle of Baltizaar]], in which his [[Komari Vosa|former]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] had been abducted by the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] cult, could no longer abide the poor decisions of the Order's 'archaic' [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] with regard to the indolent, 'wretched state of the Republic'—which he felt needed to be 'torn down and built up again from the ground up,' an action that possibly required a [[Clone Wars/Legends|civil war]], he'd told him); their meeting together was also the occasion that an authentically surprised Palpatine first heard of the ancient Jedi [[Force vision/Legends|prophecy]] of a redeemer, or '[[Chosen One/Legends|chosen one]],' who would bring balance to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and restore order: Dooku had expressed to the Senator his belief that the Jedi could fulfill the prophecy on their own if they were but willing to "unleash the full powers of the Force."<ref name="SWDP" />

Palpatine announced to the Naberries that his purpose in coming to the docks was urgent: for if Naboo stood a chance of combating King Veruna's riches-inspired alignment with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] stance that [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|free-trade zones]] be taxed, he would have to be challenged and beaten in the coming election by "the right candidate." The Naberries, of course, knew immediately that Palpatine was suggesting that that candidate be their 13-year-old daughter, the [[Princess of Theed]], who, in Palpatine's eyes, was eminently qualified. As one who had enjoyed more popular support in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] than any [[Governor of Naboo/Legends|governor]] had enjoyed in generations, Padmé had become a member of the [[Legislative Youth Program/Legends|Legislative Youth Program]] at age 8, a full [[Apprentice Legislator/Legends|Apprentice Legislator]] at 11, and had gone on to engage in significant [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] work. Naboo, after all, had historically elected younger [[Queen/Legends|Queens]] than Padmé, and hers could be a reign that would last 50 years. The [[Constitution of Naboo/Legends|Naboo constitution]], Palpatine pressed, had a provision that would allow the monarchy to become hereditary for a worthy dynasty: "And what more worthy family is there than the Naberries?" The Senator reinforced his counsel by reminding them that the citizens of Naboo were exasperated with [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarchs]] like [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Tapalo]] and Veruna, and that "Padmé would allow Naboo to reinvent itself." She, moreover, would not have to take a stand on the issue of free trade zone taxation, but rather campaign only against corruption and secret deals, and the [[Foreign Affairs scandal|embarrassing]] position in which Veruna had placed Naboo. Increasingly, he told the Naberries, though he'd helped put their monarch on the throne, Palpatine had found himself in recent years opposite Veruna on practically every issue, including the [[Veruna's tower/Legends|library]] the King built and the credits he lavished on creating a [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|space force]] for Naboo during his 12-year reign. The Senator assured them that Veruna could be defeated and that he would lend them not only his, but also the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] unqualified support to ensure that Padmé was successful in her campaign. "Faced with Padmé as competition," Palpatine concluded, "perhaps Veruna will see the light and [[Eriadu Trade Summit|abdicate]]." In the end, the Naberries, delighted to learn that Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] knew of their daughter, were in accord with Palpatine's proposition and would present it to Padmé.<ref name="SWDP" />

=== Separatist Crisis ===
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the RRM (and its newly formed subgroup, the '''Refugee Resettlement Coalition''') oversaw the temporary settlement of those displaced by the closure of worlds joining the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The ten worlds of the Coalition were [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Monastery/Legends|Monastery]], [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]], [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]], [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]], [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]], [[Ord Tessebok]], [[Garos IV]], and [[Ord Varee]]. Former chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] presided over the opening of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to refugee settlement.

After a series of [[Plot_to_assassinate_Senator_Amidala/Legends|assassination attempts]], Padmé, now the Senator of Naboo and her Jedi protector, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], covertly journeyed from Coruscant to Naboo on an RRM vessel.<ref name="AOTCn" />
